5 The recursive algorithm for the Recursion() function is defined in pseudocode as follows:
FUNCTION Recursion(A, B : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
IF A <= 100
THEN
RETURN 1
ELSE
IF A > B
THEN
RETURN 5 + Recursion(A - 1, B)
ELSE
RETURN 10 + Recursion(A – 10, B)
ENDIF
ENDIF
ENDFUNCTION
